newsitem.title: south korea: S.Korea bond yields close higher on gloomy outlook.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea bond yields close higher on gloomy outlook.

text.p: South Korea's key bond yields closed higher on Monday on fears that corporate bond issues would grow next month, while short-term liquidity remained tight, dealers said.
Overnight call rate rose as banks retained a conservative attitude with the first half of the year drawing to a close.
* 3-yr corporates close at 11.75 pct vs Saturday's 11.65
* 3-mth CDs close at 11.85 pct vs Saturday's 11.80
* Average overnight call at 11.21 pct vs Saturday's 11.20
The overnight call rate slightly rose as short-term cash liquidity remained tight, partly because of rising cash demand from companies towards the end of the month.
Three-month CD yields also closed higher, affected by the tight liquidity situation.
